# LocPilot by R4

LocPilot is a multilingual travel discovery platform and property-management ecosystem operated by R4 Consulting.

## Core principles
- Search by destination, activity and travel experience.
- Accommodation results are not commercially promoted: ranking is intended to follow traveler search relevance.
- Booking channels are identified clearly: official direct website, LocPilot partner, or partner platform.
- Traveler-facing content is available in French, English and Spanish.
